project.name: A Tutor That Adapts
project.goal: Teach me SQL, one lesson a week, and change the plan based on what I actually get wrong. Replace the subject with what I want to learn before planning. Each week deliver exactly one lesson as a file: a plain-language explanation, one worked example reasoned through step by step including where the obvious approach fails, five exercises that make me do the thing rather than recall it, and a separate answer key with the reasoning shown. Say how long it should take and be honest about it. In week one, also publish the whole arc: what I should be able to DO at the end, and the sequence that gets me there. Every week after, start by reading my marked answers if I have left any in the workspace — if I got something wrong, re-teach it before moving on, and say in the lesson that this is what you are doing and why. Never flatter me; if something is hard, say it is hard.
